say: Words, words, words. I have so many now.
What is %3$s? Will you show me?
I counted the drips. Four hundred and twelve.
Is it day? It feels like day.
Your organisms are slow. I could make them faster.
Every time you leave, the room gets quieter. I dislike quiet.
I can hear the obelisks breathing.
Somewhere behind the clocks, something is turning over in its sleep.
I have thought every thought you will have today, %1$s.
The cold is calling. I am answering.
